newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan rice crop conditions slightly above normal.
newsitem.headline: Japan rice crop conditions slightly above normal.

text.p: Rice growing conditions in Japan as of September 15 were slightly better than normal with favourable weather conditions since mid-July in most regions, the Agriculture Ministry said on Thursday.

"Although rice growth in northern Japan was slightly off due to insufficient sunshine and slightly low temperatures in July, good overall weather conditions in other areas since mid-July supported rice growth," a ministry official said.
Industry sources said that a bumper rice crop was likely this year, and this was likely to push up domestic rice inventories further.
